title: Your 20s Money Plan: 20 Moves That Matter
description:
Your 20s are the most powerful money decade of your life. $200 a month started at 22 could grow to about $655,000 by 65. Wait until 32 and it's about $309,000. In this video I look at your 20s from three angles: the numbers (what starting early is really worth), the 5 psychological traps that catch almost everyone, and 20 specific money moves, in order.

Get The Ryan Rover Money Playbook: [LINK HERE]
